blue.purpose: Owns whole regions in both themes: the search band, primary button, search submit, badges, chart bars; caret, focus border and checkbox accent.

blue-press.purpose: Hover and press of every blue fill, in both themes.

blue-text.purpose: Every blue word and line icon on light grounds (6.02:1 on Blue Wash).

sky.purpose: Focus rings and selection only, in both themes. White on it fails (2.33:1).

ink.purpose: Outline and text of demo markers, demo notice text, selection text (light).

plate.purpose: The one reversed plate per screen: the doctor page's WhatsApp contact bar (white on it 13.92:1).

on-blue.purpose: Literal #fff for text and icons on Clinic Signal Blue and on the plate; constant across themes (not a custom property).

ground.purpose: Page ground the slips lie on; chips, unavailable stub, row hover.

slip.purpose: Slips, groups, top bar, tab bar, tiles, search field, segmented track.

wash.purpose: Tinted fill for labels, active tabs and segments, quiet buttons, the stub WhatsApp action, row icons, the empty photo circle, the demo notice.

line.purpose: 1px dividers, field borders, top bar and tab bar edges.

tear.purpose: The 1.5px dashed tear line on slips; thin shelf scrollbar from 48rem.

text-2.purpose: Secondary text: roles, addresses, cell labels, sources, inactive tabs, search placeholder.

warn.purpose: Text of highlighted blanks in legal drafts.

warn-wash.purpose: Fill behind highlighted blanks in legal drafts.

blue-text-dark.purpose: Blue words and line icons in dark (7.02:1 on dark Blue Wash, 8.26:1 on the dark slip).

ink-dark.purpose: Demo outlines and notice text in dark (7.46:1 on dark Blue Wash). Selection text too, where it fails on sky (1.19:1; drift).

plate-dark.purpose: The plate in dark: Clinic Signal Blue, since deep ink vanishes on near-black (white on it 5.24:1).

slip-dark.purpose: Navy slips, groups, bars, tiles and the search field.

wash-dark.purpose: Tinted fill for labels, active tabs and segments, quiet buttons, the stub WhatsApp action, row icons, the empty photo circle, the demo notice.

line-dark.purpose: 1px dividers, field borders, top bar and tab bar edges.

tear-dark.purpose: The 1.5px dashed tear line on slips; thin shelf scrollbar from 48rem.

text-dark.purpose: Primary text in dark (16.92:1 on the dark ground).

text-2-dark.purpose: Secondary text in dark (8.11:1 on the dark slip).

text-3-dark.purpose: Placeholders in dark (5.82:1 on the dark slip).

warn-dark.purpose: Text of highlighted blanks in legal drafts.

warn-wash-dark.purpose: Fill behind highlighted blanks in legal drafts.

display.purpose: Screen titles, search band title, the doctor's name on the profile header, the first letter in an empty photo circle, admin stat numbers.

title.purpose: Slip names, shelf and section titles, empty-state titles.

body.purpose: Running text and inputs; tabular numerals; prose capped at 44rem.

body-strong.purpose: Buttons, contact plate, active top tab and segment (700); fact values, FAQ questions, inactive segments (500).

label.purpose: Meta, the stub cell, labels, chips, tab labels, breadcrumbs, «عرض الكل», source lines, footer.

themes.picker: Settings → المظهر (تلقائي / فاتح / داكن), src/components/ThemePicker.tsx; stored in localStorage "panivo-theme" (light | dark; auto removes it); applied before paint by an inline script in src/app/layout.tsx.
themes.logo: src/components/Wordmark.tsx renders both supplied artworks; .logo-light (wordmark-header.webp, made for white) shows in light, .logo-dark (wordmark-footer.webp, transparent) in dark. The footer always uses the transparent artwork.

shadows.name: shadow
shadows.purpose: Resting slips, groups, FAQ items, empty states, round buttons, the segmented track.

shadows.name: slip-hover
shadows.purpose: Slip hover under a fine pointer only. Literal in globals.css; not themed (drift in dark).

shadows.name: shadow-float
shadows.purpose: Floating tab bar and the contact plate.

shadows.name: field-on-blue
shadows.purpose: The search field lifting off the blue band, both themes.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: All keyboard focus, both themes; fields use 0 0 0 3px rgba(20, 180, 255, 0.35) with a blue border.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Spring-like settle for press feedback and the FAQ plus-icon rotation (200ms).

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Scale-on-press: round button 0.92, heart 0.88, tab 0.94, tile and stub action 0.96, button and plate 0.97, slip 0.985.

motion.name: state
motion.value: 150ms ease (colour, segments), 200ms ease (tab background, slip shadow)

motion.name: theme-switch
motion.purpose: Theme changes apply at once by toggling data-theme; no cross-fade.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Gutter 1.5rem; band content capped at 44rem; shelves become minmax(21rem, 1fr) with a thin scrollbar; tiles go to 16px; doctor page centres at 44rem; slip addresses truncate to one line.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: The three tabs move into the top bar; floating tab bar and top-bar heart hidden; foot padding 3rem.

openDecisions.name: perforation-notches
openDecisions.note: Notches on the slip's tear line were considered and deferred; the tear is a dashed line only.

retired.name: verification-stamp
retired.note: Stamp component, its CSS and the «موثّق» wording removed by the owner; the doctor's photo leads the slip and the doctor page instead.

retired.name: clinic-pages
retired.note: No public clinic pages or clinic slips; clinics exist in admin as the doctor's workplace.

retired.name: correction-form
retired.note: Corrections go by email (CONTACT_EMAIL); the public form is gone.

outOfSystem.note: Static intro page built with a different kit (design-taste-frontend); not part of this system.

narrative.overview:
Every doctor in PANIVO is a white appointment slip lying on a light-gray counter, and every slip leads with the doctor's own face: a round photo the doctor approved, or, until one is approved, a quiet Blue Wash circle holding the first letter of the name. There is no verification badge. Every listed doctor has consented, so the system does not decorate trust; it shows it as plain facts, each with its source and the date it was last checked. Everything else stays quiet so the face, the name and the WhatsApp action are the three things a patient sees.

The world is Arabic-first and right-to-left, set in one sturdy sans (Readex Pro) at exactly four sizes, in Modern Standard Arabic. Brand blue does not sprinkle; it owns whole regions (the search band, the primary button, badges), and that band stays brand blue in both themes. Deep ink blue is the one reversed plate per screen (the doctor page's WhatsApp bar) and the outline of demo markers. Density follows the delivery-app reference the owner named: large cards, one swipeable shelf per specialty, very few words. The site lists doctors only; clinics are a doctor's workplace, named on the slip, never a page of their own.

There are two themes. Light is white slips on cool light gray around the owner's three blues. Dark follows the phone unless the visitor picks a theme in Settings (المظهر: تلقائي / فاتح / داكن): deep navy slips on a near-black ground, light blue for words and outlines, and the plate turning Signal Blue. The category default this world refuses is a white list of interchangeable doctor cards with star ratings and stock portraits: no ratings, no rank numbers, no portrait the doctor did not approve. The separate static intro page (`public/intro/index.html`) was built with a different kit and is outside this system; do not take values from it.
keyCharacteristics: White slips (18px corners, soft tinted shadow) on a counter-gray ground; in dark, navy slips on near-black.
Every slip and the doctor page lead with the doctor's round photo (or the first-letter circle).
A dashed tear line separates the facts from the stub: one «الخبرة» cell, then the heart and WhatsApp.
Brand blue owns regions in both themes; words in blue use Blue Text; sky blue appears only as focus and selection.
One face, four sizes, three weights (400, 500, 700); tabular numerals everywhere.
Floating pill tab bar on phones and tablets; from 64rem the three tabs move into the top bar.
Logical (inline/block) properties throughout, so the layout is native RTL.

rules.name: The Three Blues, Three Jobs Rule
rules.body: Clinic Signal Blue owns regions, deep ink is the plate and the demo outline, Focus Sky is focus. A blue doing another blue's job is wrong.

rules.name: The Blue Words Rule
rules.body: Blue text and blue line icons always take Blue Text, never Clinic Signal Blue, so they stay legible on white, on Blue Wash and on the dark slip.

rules.name: The Band Stays Blue Rule
rules.body: The search band, the primary button and the badges keep Clinic Signal Blue with white in both themes; dark mode changes the ground around them, not the brand.

rules.name: The Sky Is Not a Fill Rule
rules.body: Focus Sky never carries text and never fills a button, badge or band: white on it is 2.33:1. It exists only as focus rings and selection.

rules.name: The One Plate Rule
rules.body: At most one reversed plate per screen, and on the public site that plate is the doctor page's WhatsApp contact bar. Demo markers are outlined in ink, never filled.

rules.name: The Logo-Only Gradient Rule
rules.body: Gradients exist only inside the supplied logo artwork in `public/brand/`. Every surface in the interface is a flat colour.

rules.name: The Four Sizes Rule
rules.body: Only `--fs-s` 13px, `--fs-m` 16px, `--fs-l` 20px and `--fs-xl` 28px exist. A new role takes one of the four sizes and a weight; it never adds a fifth size.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Readex Pro is the only family, self-hosted with the site; no external font service, no second family for numbers or display.

rules.name: The Latin-Date Rule
rules.body: Dates are written YYYY/MM/DD in Latin digits, as on Saudi forms, in the source line beside every fact: «المصدر · تحقق YYYY/MM/DD».

rules.name: The Tinted Shadow Rule
rules.body: Light shadows are tinted with deep ink (rgba 0, 26, 137), dark shadows are black; both are soft and negative-spread. No hard offsets.

rules.name: The Two Heights Rule
rules.body: A surface either rests (slip shadow) or floats (float shadow). Bars attached to an edge stay flat with a hairline.

dos: **Do** keep blue in whole regions (band, primary button, badges) in both themes, and use Blue Text for every blue word or line icon.
**Do** lead every slip and the doctor page with the doctor's round photo, or the first-letter circle until an approved photo exists.
**Do** put the source plus last-checked date («المصدر · تحقق YYYY/MM/DD») beside every fact on the doctor page.
**Do** keep the slip's anatomy: name, role, address and demo label at the start, photo at the end, a 1.5px dashed tear line, then the «الخبرة» cell and the heart plus WhatsApp action in the stub.
**Do** define every colour as a custom property with a light value and a dark value, and set dark values in both the `data-theme="dark"` block and the `prefers-color-scheme: dark` block.
**Do** use only the four sizes (13, 16, 20, 28px) and the weights 400, 500 and 700 of Readex Pro.
**Do** keep press feedback to small scales on a 120ms `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`, and let `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` cut transitions and animations.
**Do** keep touch targets at 2.75rem or larger and write every edge with logical properties.
**Do** mark demo profiles with the outlined Outline Ink label and the «تجريبي» notice strip.
donts: **Don't** put white text on Focus Sky (2.33:1) or use it for anything but focus and selection.
**Don't** use Clinic Signal Blue for small blue text; it is a fill colour.
**Don't** add a second reversed plate to a screen, and don't fill demo markers.

**Don't** use gradients anywhere outside the supplied logo artwork, and don't recolour, stretch, shadow, filter or add effects to the logo or wordmark; dark mode swaps to the supplied transparent artwork instead.
**Don't** show star ratings, rating numbers, review counts, rank numbers, "top" ribbons or any visual that implies an order of merit; public order is set by the owner and never described.
**Don't** add verification badges, seals, stamps or «موثّق» wording; every listed doctor consented, and the facts with their sources carry the trust.
**Don't** use stock photos, generated faces or any portrait without the doctor's recorded approval.
**Don't** give clinics public pages or slips; a clinic appears only as the doctor's workplace in the address line and the facts.
**Don't** add a fifth type size or a second typeface.
